# Remote Retrieval

Remote Retrieval automates the logistics of managing equipment returns, providing efficient tracking and management of laptop and monitor returns.

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/remote-retrieval/.

## Actions

- **Get All Orders** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of all orders.
- **RemoteRetrieval: Validate User** (read-only): Validate the provided api key.
- **Get Company Details** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information for a company.
